category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: 'Slow speed', 'One file, one thread', 'Wait to download again', 'Captcha', 'Wait your turn', 'Download link will expire soon', 'Download files up to 2 GB', 'Upload files up to 2 GB', 'Limited lifetime storage'.

per_object_cap.stated: free downloads are capped at 2 GB per file; premium raises the download and upload cap to 5 GB per file

retention.stated: 'Files kept on server forever' is listed as a premium benefit; the free column says 'Limited lifetime storage' without a number

egress.terms: No byte allowance is published anywhere on the premium page. Speed is sold as 'Download speed - up to 1000 Mbps' with 'Download accelerators support'; the free tier is 'Slow speed, one file, one thread'.

interface_detail: No API page found; the account is a web login.
tooling: browser; download accelerators explicitly supported on premium (the vendor names them as a benefit)
chaining: A flat monthly price with no byte counter is the cleanest fit for a client whose volume is unknown month to month, at roughly three times 1fichier's annual-equivalent price.

limits.value: 2 GB per file on free, 5 GB on premium
free is 'one file, one thread' with a wait; premium is 'up to 1000 Mbps'

limits_note: Age confirmation is required during payment; the page states it as a payment step, not a document upload.
binding_note: With no byte cap published, the only hard number that can stop 1 TiB of monthly transfer is the 5 GB per-file ceiling, which forces an archive into at least 220 parts.

identity_cost.detail: Account is e-mail based, but the payment page adds 'Age confirmed during the payment' and a Paymer check option; the card is the identity step.

reliability_note: Files are kept 'forever' only on premium; the free tier deletes on a clock the vendor does not publish.
confidence_note: Every number is from the vendor premium page read today. The absence of a byte cap is the vendor's silence, not a measured fact, so the verdict keeps a caveat.

evidence.proved: premium: 'High speed downloads', 'Parallel downloads', 'Download without delay', 'No captcha', 'Upload files up to 5 GB', 'Files kept on server forever', 'Download speed - up to 1000 Mbps'; free: 'Slow speed', 'One file, one thread', 'Download files up to 2 GB', 'Limited lifetime storage'; prices 16/33/59/99 EUR
premium raises the upload cap to 5 GB, keeps files forever and confirms age during payment

price_per_tb_month: EUR 14.55 per TiB-month at the monthly rate (EUR 16 / 33 days) with no byte cap published
notes: Second-cheapest flat-rate key after 1fichier Premium, and the only one whose free tier the 2026 test called 'clean' rather than a paywall. The 5 GB per-file cap is the real cost: a 60 GB archive is twelve parts before deduplication. No programmatic path found: No API page found; the account is a web login.

extras.price_ladder_reported: EUR 16 for 1 month + 3 bonus days (EUR 0.48/day); EUR 33 for 3 months; EUR 59 for 6 months; EUR 99 for 1 year
extras.conversion: MiB/s = 1,048,576 B/s; vendor GB = 1e9 B; GiB = 1.073741824e9 B; 1 TiB/month = 0.4045 MiB/s sustained
